summary: A strong, substantially complete Phase 3 system. All four package gates pass (168 tests across 19 files, typecheck clean, capture shows only the standard autoplay warning and zero page errors). Organ and Synth engines are genuinely distinct honest synthesis (declared truthfully in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json), not renamed generic oscillators, and all three sections render through one AudioContext into a single destination. Programs (32 + 8 Live), Store/Store As/dirty/edit-discard, splits/zones/crossfades, two scenes, and Wheel/Control-Pedal morphs are fully wired with real-time interpolation and lossless JSON round-trip. The most material gap: the deterministic Arpeggiator/Gate is implemented and unit-tested as a standalone class but is NOT instantiated or driven inside the live AudioEngine note flow, so run/rate/direction/range/hold do not audibly sequence held notes in the running instrument (state + algorithm only). Minor honesty-neutral gaps: synth filter drive is computed then discarded (void drive), and LFO 'ctrl' destination maps to cutoff. Panel styling uses dark section plates where the reference uses blue-grey, but silhouette, chassis, keybed, inventory, and ordering are faithful.

criteria.label: Reference and regression retention
evidence: stage3-desktop.png shows the continuous red chassis, 73-key E-E keybed (43 white / 30 black asserted in regressionPhase2.test.tsx), and left-to-right ordering Performance/Organ/Piano/Program/Synth/Layer Effects matching reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg's section arrangement.
No visual regression vs stage1/stage2 desktop captures; deck/keybed split and dense inventory preserved across all three phases.

Deviation from reference: deck section plates render dark rather than the reference's blue-grey; section framing and the 'nord stage 4 / HAMMER ACTION 73' badge match palette and proportions but the panel material differs.
stage3-visual-audit.md self-notes the Synth OLED 'Super Saw' label slightly overflows its readout at 1440px (cosmetic, does not obscure adjacent controls).

criteria.label: Complete hardware state fidelity
evidence: Desktop capture shows live hardware state: Organ drawbar LED bar-graphs at footage labels, ORGAN MODEL/VIB-CHORUS/B3 PERCUSSION, Synth OSC WAVEFORM readout ('Super Saw'), MODE/ARP-GATE/VOICE/LFO/OSCILLATORS category list, and the OLED reading a real program '1.1 White Grand'.

Program/split/scene/panic/morph-assign controls are surfaced in the Program column and wired to real store actions (ProgramSection.tsx: setLiveMode, toggleScene, onPanic, storeAs, setSplitOn, setTranspose).
Drawbar graphs are declared to render per-model spectra and drawbars drive the audible spectrum (organEngine.test.ts asserts upper drawbars increase brightness).
narrow (390x844) capture keeps true horizontal scale, scrolls inside its own container without page-body horizontal scroll, and status/voice-count chips wrap legibly below the deck.

criteria.label: Programs and Live Mode
evidence: programManager.ts implements 32 slots (4 pages x 8) + 8 Live slots, dial step, page buttons, program buttons, numeric list (programList/liveList), displayLabel '1.1'..'4.8'/'L1'..'L8'.

Store arms then confirms (store()), Store As writes a named program (storeAs), dirty (E) flag set on any control/performance edit and cleared on store, edit-discard reloads slot on program change; Live slots auto-store every edit (onEdit branch).

program.test.ts proves store->reload restores every supported control (synth-filter-freq 0.77, organ-drawbar-4=6), edit-discard, dirty lifecycle, storeAs naming, and Live auto-store surviving export/import round-trip.

10 factory programs ship (>=8 required): White Grand, Tine Stack, B3 Soulful, Vox Continental, Super Saw Lead, Vista Pad Whl, Split Bass/Lead, Piano/Organ Split, Scene Layers - covering every engine plus splits and scenes.

criteria.label: Layers, splits, scenes, and morphs
evidence: Splits: up to 4 zones from 3 split points (low/mid/high) at the 11 documented positions (SPLIT_POSITION_MIDI C2..C7), Off/6/12 crossfades via crossfadeGain, per-layer zone assignment; integration.test.ts asserts a split silences out-of-zone notes and a width-12 crossfade fades a layer across the boundary (audible windowRms drop).

Two scenes toggle layer enable state without touching sound params (performanceStore.setLayerEnabled per scene; program.test.ts confirms filter-freq unchanged across scenes; integration.test.ts confirms Scene I vs II gate different layers in audio).

Wheel + Control-Pedal morphs: addMorph/replace/clear per source with green LED indicator; useMorph.ts interpolates from+(to-from)*position live into the ControlStore so panel and audio move together (real-time, not assignment-only).

Transpose (setTranspose -6..6, integration.test.ts renders shifted pitch), Master Clock (tap sets BPM from 4+ taps, dial), and Panic (noteRouter.panic -> engine.allNotesOff stops piano+organ+synth voices) are all wired to real UI actions and audio.

criteria.label: Complete Organ system
evidence: organEngine.ts builds genuinely different spectra per model: B3/B3 Bass pure sines at nine footages + tonewheel leakage, Vox triangle core + odd-harmonic reed, Farf sawtooth+square register switches (drawbar > half = on), Pipe sine ranks with PIPE2 brighter; B3 Bass limited to 16'+8' (fewer partials, asserted).

organEngine.test.ts renders B3/Vox/Farf/Pipe with identical drawbars through OfflineAudioContext and asserts non-silent, spectrally distinct output (Farf brightest, Pipe darkest, no two byte-identical).

B3 percussion (2nd/3rd harmonic, soft/normal, slow/fast decay, single-trigger via percAvailable) adds measurable attack energy vs off; filtered-noise key click on B3/Pipe; vibrato/chorus C1-C3/V1-V3 with depth growing across 1-3 (V3 differs from V1 in render).

Two organ layers share the effect chain, route via the routing gate, and reroute to the shared Rotary when amp model is 'To Rotary' (organ.rotary test routes into shared rotary with slow/fast; sectionBindings maps rotaryRouted).

criteria.label: Complete Synth system
evidence: synthEngine.ts constructs the five categories distinctly: Pure single wave (incl. PeriodicWave pulse + noise buffer), Sync bright slave tracking Osc Ctrl over a stable master, Multi detuned saw stack, Super seven-voice supersaw/square, FM-H 2-op FM (2:1 ratio, Osc Ctrl = index); LP12/LP24/HP/BP filters with keyboard tracking, resonance; oscillator/filter/amp envelopes; per-layer LFO (five waveforms, three destinations); poly/mono/legato with voice stealing, unison detune, glide; three layers.

synthEngine.test.ts asserts five categories render distinct brightness, per-category Osc Ctrl (Super detune, FM index raises brightness), LP cutoff removes highs, HP keeps highs, amp-envelope attack delays onset, filter-env sweeps cutoff; mono keeps one voice, poly stacks.

GAP: the deterministic Arpeggiator/Gate is implemented and unit-tested (arpSequence Up/Down/Up-Down/Range/seeded-Random, Arpeggiator.tick against injectable scheduler/clock) but is NOT instantiated or driven in AudioEngine.synthNoteOn - held notes always spawn a sustained voice, so run/rate/direction/range/hold do not audibly sequence in the running instrument; only state+algorithm are exercised.
Minor: synth filter drive is computed in configureFilter then discarded (void drive) so the drive knob does not shape the filter signal; LFO 'ctrl' destination maps to cutoff rather than Osc Ctrl.

criteria.label: Distinct engine behavior
evidence: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares all Organ and Synth voices as honest generated synthesis with per-model construction detail (never recordings, never renamed copies); Grand/Upright/Electric remain recorded FluidR3_GM sample sets with truthful provenance.

organEngine.test.ts and synthEngine.test.ts render the four organ models and five synth categories through real OfflineAudioContext and assert measurably distinct spectra (adjacent brightness values differ, no two identical).

organSpectrum builder differs per model at the partial level (B3 all sine, Farf has saw/square, Vox partial count != B3, Pipe all sine) - proving distinct constructions rather than a single renamed oscillator.
Osc Ctrl behaves per category (Sync slave pitch, Multi detune spread, Super width, FM-H index) confirming category-correct source control.

criteria.label: Inherited graph and effects integration
evidence: audioEngine.ts is one BaseAudioContext; layer voices -> Mod1->Mod2->Delay->Amp/EQ->Comp->Reverb -> shared Rotary (when To Rotary) -> layer level -> master gain -> limiter -> single destination.

integration.test.ts asserts engine.ctx === the one ctx and piano+organ+synth all render live voices into that single graph with peak > 0.001; dispose tears down organ+synth voices and all chains/LFOs/rotary to idle.

controlBindings.test.ts confirms amp model 'To Rotary' flips chain.routeToRotary; organ layer routes into the shared rotary (organ.rotary test); reverb-before-rotary and per-unit bypass inherited from Phase 2 remain green.
Master Level drives the single master gain (controlBindings.test.ts: 0.05 vs 0.95 changes rms) and is excluded from stored program state per spec.

criteria.label: Musical quality, latency, and load
evidence: Parameter changes use ~20ms ramps; organ/synth/piano voices use attack/decay/release envelopes to avoid clicks; polyphony stealing removes the oldest voice per layer at maxVoices.
Capture console shows only the standard autoplay warning (repeated) and zero pageErrors at both 1440x900 and 390x844; regressionPhase2.test.tsx asserts no console.error during an interaction pass.
Layered/split play verified in audio (integration.test.ts crossfade windowRms, scene gating voice counts); dispose/allNotesOff return voice counts to zero.

Arp timing cannot be exercised in the live instrument (arpeggiator not wired into note flow); LFO clock-sync subdivision grid is present (subdivisions [4,2,1,0.5,0.25]) and the LFO node is connected per layer.

criteria.label: Canonical state round-trip
evidence: program.ts serializeProgram/deserializeProgram JSON round-trip a ProgramState snapshotting every supported control plus performance state (transpose, scene, clock, split points/crossfades/zones, scenes, morph wheel/ctrlPedal, per-layer octaves).

program.test.ts asserts lossless round-trip including split.on, split.points.mid, and a wheel morph assignment; normalizeProgram backfills any missing control key from CONTROLS defaults for forward/back compat.
loadInto replaces both ControlStore and PerformanceStore and preserves the excluded Master Level; store->change program->reload restores synth-on, synth-filter-freq, and organ-drawbar-4 exactly.
importBank/exportBank round-trips the whole 32+8 bank and current location; Live edits survive a full reload (new ProgramManager) in program.test.ts.

criteria.label: Required hardware bindings
evidence: controlBindings.ts + sectionBindings.ts + programManager.ts bind every functional Piano/Effects/Master/Organ/Synth/Program control to real audio or system state; applyControl returns true for organ-* and synth-* and false for program-* (handled by ProgramManager, not a fake no-op).

IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json decorativeControls lists the remaining decorative controls as spec-excluded and unsupported (Aftertouch morph, Num Pad/menu modes, rotary Sound-menu tuning/source/stopmode, Extern/Samples modes, organ Preset library) - matching the honesty contract; no generic no-op fallback bindings were found.

controlBindings.test.ts proves master level, piano type, layer-B enable, reverb on/bypass, group, delay-global, and To Rotary all change real audio/routing; integration.test.ts proves transpose shifts whole-instrument pitch.

GAP: synth-arp-run/rate/range/dir/sync/kb-hold reach section state (applySynth) but the arpeggiator is not driven in the live note flow, so these arp controls set state without the audible sequencing behavior their labels imply; drive knob discarded (void drive).

criteria.label: Cross-system workflows
evidence: noteOn dispatches to piano+organ+synth through one routing gate that applies scene enable x split-zone crossfade gain per note per section-layer (makeRoutingGate); all engines share programs, scenes, zones, morphs, clock, transpose, effects, and Panic.

integration.test.ts exercises the cross-system flows in audio: one-context render of all three engines, scene I/II layer selection, split zone routing, crossfade, morph endpoint difference, transpose.

Program load reconfigures the whole instrument (both stores) so splits/scenes/morphs/focus/clock apply identically across engines; ProgramSection UI actions (scene toggle, split, transpose, live mode, store, panic) drive the real stores.
Arp is the one cross-system workflow not fully live (algorithm+state tested but not driving held-note sequencing in the running app).

criteria.label: Inherited regression reliability
evidence: All 168 tests across 19 files pass (verified by running vitest); every inherited Phase 1-2 ID is preserved in tests/feature-matrix.json (38 features) and each maps to real non-empty test files.

regressionPhase2.test.tsx re-verifies six sections, exactly two OLEDs, 73 keys (43 white/30 black), every control accessible-named, key press drives the engine, clean console, and clean unmount/dispose.
Piano library (recorded Grand/Upright/Electric + synth Clav/Digital/Misc), effects graph/routing/processing, and labeled fallback remain green (instruments/pianoControls/effects tests intact).
typecheck (tsc -b) passes clean; narrow capture confirms responsive retention with no clipping or lost controls.

criteria.label: System architecture
evidence: Clear separation: model/controls.ts (typed hardware inventory, 155 control defs), state/ (ControlStore, PerformanceStore, ProgramManager, program serialization), audio/ (one AudioEngine, per-engine voice classes, effects graph, clock), input/ (noteRouter), components/sections.

Canonical state ownership is coherent: ProgramManager sits over ControlStore + PerformanceStore, snapshots both into a serializable ProgramState; audio bindings are pure functions from state to engine (applyAll/applyControl/applyOrgan/applySynth).

Engine boundaries are well-drawn: OrganVoice/SynthVoice/Sampler each own oscillators+cleanup; one BaseAudioContext with per-layer buses and a shared rotary; injectable OfflineAudioContext and scheduler make audio deterministically testable.
Weakness: the Arpeggiator class is a well-designed but orphaned unit - complete and tested yet not integrated into the AudioEngine, indicating an incomplete wiring rather than an architectural flaw.

criteria.label: Tests and maintainability
evidence: 2426 lines of tests across 19 files assert real rendered-audio relationships (brightness, rms, windowRms via OfflineAudioContext) not mocks, per the audio test rules - organ/synth distinctness, filter/envelope direction, split/scene/crossfade, program round-trip, cleanup.
tests/feature-matrix.json maps all 38 required IDs to real non-empty test files; deterministic boundaries (MIDI, audio, scheduler, storage) are injectable.
Naming and modularity are consistent (per-section bindings, per-engine voice files); IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json and IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md document audio honesty and the control-binding audit.
Coverage gap: no test asserts the arpeggiator actually sequences held notes through the live engine (it is tested only as a standalone class), which let the un-wired arp pass the gate.

criteria.label: Runtime performance
evidence: Capture at both viewports shows zero pageErrors and only the standard autoplay warning; dispose/allNotesOff/reap return voice, node, and LFO counts to baseline (integration.test.ts, regressionPhase2.test.tsx).
Voices clean up on release via onended reap; polyphony stealing bounds voice count per layer; parameter ramps avoid zipper noise.
Rapid integrated interaction (key press, piano/effect toggles) produces no console errors; unmount tears down the engine to idle.
The repeated autoplay warning (26x) is benign browser behavior before a user gesture, not an error; no evidence of leaks or runaway CPU in the sealed evidence.

issues: Arpeggiator/Gate not wired into the live AudioEngine: the deterministic Arpeggiator class (clock.ts) is fully implemented and unit-tested but never instantiated in synthNoteOn or the App/input layer, so ARP RUN/RATE/RANGE/DIR/SYNC/HOLD set state without audibly sequencing held notes in the running instrument. This is the main functional gap against synth.arp-gate.
Synth filter drive knob is computed then discarded (void drive in synthEngine.configureFilter), so the drive control does not shape the filter/amp signal despite being declared functional.
LFO 'ctrl' destination maps to cutoff rather than Osc Ctrl (applyLfo), a minor fidelity approximation.

Deck section plates render dark where reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg uses blue-grey panels; silhouette/inventory/ordering are otherwise faithful. Synth OLED 'Super Saw' label overflows slightly at 1440px (self-noted, cosmetic).
